solution_deployment: Prefer prior managed solution version rollback; keep exported packages.
flow_change: Restore prior solution version or documented prior flow definition; disable only with impact note.
plugin_change: Rollback to prior assembly/step version and validate server-side behavior.
app_release: Rollback managed app version or restore prior app package.
environment_variables: Restore prior value from evidence record; secrets remain redacted.
connection_references: Restore prior connection binding or approved replacement owner.
